record.label: AQ H4 square is an exact Stein discrepancy
record.summary: For half-scaled AQ cores, the symmetric Stein matrix minus covariance is exactly a typed H1/H2 feature built from A_i u_j+A_j u_i and A_i circle A_j. Its covariance is the full three-pairing q4 square lift.
record.terminal_criterion: Solved as a finite noncommutative identity; it does not supply a cheap future Hessian contraction.
